issues.title: Ingest White County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $51,279,177 across 33 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($11,440,443), Law Enforcement Tax Fund ($11,166,175), County Road Fund ($10,108,638). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile Tax Assessor (County General Fund)
issues.detail: The ordinance (p. 1) and the General Fund summary (p. 78) print $1,749,469.57. The Assessor's detail pages print a total of $1,741,384.41 (p. 26), and the categories add to that. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
